Check for required package dependencies

check_packages.Rd

Verifies that required packages are installed and can be loaded. Throws an error with a helpful message listing any missing packages.

Usage

check_packages(pkgs)

Arguments

pkgs

character vector of package names to check

Value

Invisible NULL if all packages are available. Otherwise throws an error.

Details

Uses requireNamespace() to check package availability without loading them. This is preferred over require() for package dependency checks as it doesn't attach packages to the search path.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Check single package
check_packages("data.table")

# Check multiple packages
check_packages(c("ggplot2", "dplyr"))
} # }
